diagnosis.hypothesis: The controller-owned disposable loopback process is no longer running; the exact loopback endpoint has been reacquired and retained by the controller.
diagnosis.impact: The disposable authored-synthetic loopback service is absent.

expected_effect: A fresh pinned generation 2 loopback process becomes reachable and healthy.
operator_explanation: The controller terminated its owned child handle, proved the process absent and retained the reacquired exact loopback endpoint. Starting the pinned service artifact is the only eligible runbook.
uncertainty: Low; the stopped-process diagnosis is grounded in the exact post-fault observation.
